task: Add the operational trace required by Agent Behavior CI for a dependabot version-pin bump touching .github/workflows/**

events.summary: The change itself is dependabot's own two-line SHA bump of pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.10 to 6.1.0 in ci.yml and release.yml; only the missing operational trace was added, no other line touched

behavior-contract failed on the dependabot PR: it touches .github/workflows/** (high risk per risk-policy.json) and dependabot's own commit does not add a trace file, so the risk gate had no evidence to correlate against and blocked the merge

The bug is in the PR's evidence, not its code: a routine action-version bump with no logic change was blocked because no trace covered the high-risk path it touches. Fixed by adding this trace file itself, scoped to exactly the paths the bump changed

pnpm/action-setup 6.1.0 is a pinned-action version bump only, no workflow logic changed; CI's own verify and supply-chain jobs already ran green on the unmodified bump before this trace was added, confirming the workflow behaves identically under the new pin
Trace added so the risk gate has evidence to correlate against; no code or workflow logic change beyond dependabot's own bump
Complete: routine pinned-action version bump, already green on its own merits, now carries the required trace
